title: A Sure, Strong Rock
traveler_why: Tonight is about standing steady on something that will not move, and Beau the Brave is the Traveler whose legs go wobbly on the low wall at the park — he remembers that Heavenly Father is his strong Rock, takes a brave breath, and walks the whole way: Isaiah 26:4 at a child’s scale.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because he stands strong on Heavenly Father. In Beau’s world today: Beau was learning to balance on the low wall at the park, and his legs felt wobbly and unsure. He remembered that Heavenly Father was his strong Rock, holding him steady. He took a brave breath, steadied himself, and walked the whole way! Just like Isaiah said to trust Heavenly Father, the Rock that lasts forever, Beau found his steady footing by leaning on Him.
